brief.headline: Push UFLEX from ₹385.00/KG down to ₹250.00/KG — the price Silk Polypack gives us and the market fair band — and offer faster payment in return.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250.00/KG on laminate sachets, matching Silk Polypack and the market fair band.
priceAsk.basis: We pay UFLEX ₹385.00/KG today, a 54.0% gap over Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG. The market fair band for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so ₹250.00/KG sits at the top of fair. UFLEX is charging us well above what the market and our best supplier deliver.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 30 days instead of 60 if they move to ₹250.00/KG.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 30 days earlier frees up ₹5325 of our cash, but only if the price comes down first — we need the saving to justify faster payment.

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX publishes no financial reports, so we don't know their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. That means we build our case on what we do know: our own purchase data, the market price, and credible second sources. Our ₹64788 annual spend is small for a listed flexibles giant like UFLEX, so we're not a make-or-break customer — they can afford to walk, and so can we. Push firmly on price and payment, but keep the tone professional: line up Huhtamaki and Constantia as ready alternates so UFLEX knows this business is contestable.

evidence.point: We pay UFLEX 54.0% more than Silk Polypack for the same laminate SKU.
The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typical ₹250/kg — UFLEX is well above that band.
Closing the gap to ₹250.00/KG saves us ₹22718 a year.
Imported BOPET film (the raw substrate) lands at ₹171.60/kg — UFLEX's ₹385.00/KG laminate price is more than twice the film cost.
Paying in 30 days instead of 60 frees up ₹5325 of our cash.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: A listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volumes — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Part of the global Constantia group, converts pharma blister and sachet laminates in India — strong second-source for our ORS sachets (revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health score D 31/100).

risks: UFLEX is a listed flexibles giant — our ₹64788 spend is tiny for them, so they may refuse and we must be ready to switch.
UFLEX publishes no financials, so we can't gauge how desperate or relaxed they are — treat this as an arm's-length negotiation with a big player who has options.
Huhtamaki and Constantia are credible alternates, but qualify and price them now (RFQ in parallel) so we have a live fallback if UFLEX walks.
If we offer 30-day payment without locking in ₹250.00/KG first, we give away ₹5325 of cash for nothing — price must move before terms do.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're here to close the 54.0% gap between your ₹385.00/KG and the ₹250.00/KG market price — and we can pay you faster if you meet that number.
